title: T’Vondre Sweat, Joseph Ossai flash promise of overhauled Jets defense

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: T’Vondre Sweat, Joseph Ossai flash promise of overhauled Jets defense
sources.description: There has been so much change, enough to fuel belief within a group that had no connection to a defense that finished last season ranked 29th against the run, 31st in sacks and produced a league-worst four takeaways.
